checks.summary: Output Enable is MeCom ID 2100 in the LDD protocol and CANopen object 0x2230 in the EDS; keep the UI/default key LDD_OUTPUT_EN mapped to those documented protocol identities.

checks.summary: Min Nominal Voltage is MeCom ID 2125 in the LDD protocol and CANopen object 0x2255 in the EDS; the manual warning text explains the overcurrent risk of setting the lower voltage limit too high.
Feature unlock metadata is documented by the protocol Feature Licenses table; ServiceSoftware adds license guidance text that is useful as tooltip-style metadata.
Ignore Feature FW Limit is present in the ServiceSoftware bootloader UI strings, but it is not documented as an LDD protocol parameter in 5260H; treat it as service-software UI metadata only.
